about_the_game:
Buster Jam is a playable cartoon, focused on fast-paced mini-game action. Explore comedic scenarios as Buster and Bridget, and make your way to each world's animated boss-fight. Its lively style and soundtrack hold inspiration from the '90s and early 2000s, with a splash of its own modern flair.

STORY

Evil sorcerer the Wizard has come out of his long retirement to rule the world. Demolitionists Buster and Bridget will have to make their way through a variety of zany worlds, and an onslaught of wacky boss-fight scenarios if they want to save the land from a 'Wizard-topia'. With their explosive expertise, and friends along the way, the Wizard will be no match for these go-lucky bombheads.

WHAT NOW?

Buster Jam is still in development, and planned to release soon. Wishlist the game to help us, and keep up to date with the project!
